content.comment_body: I have a question about transmitting and receiving data between a [product_name] module and a PC using Ethernet communication. For instance, I want to send commands related to ports via Ethernet without relying on the [product_name] built-in web browser. In other words, I want to send, say, the character '1' over Ethernet and have the [product_name] module set Q1 accordingly. Since I am new to this topic, I'm looking for example implementations or sample projects.
Why did you create a new topic? [url]
I created a new topic because I thought I might not have explained my question clearly in the first one.
Thread closed since the question was posted twice. The second thread about the connection and sending data is published within the [product_name] conference. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for advice on how to set up Ethernet communication between a [product_name] module and a PC, specifically aiming to send simple commands (binary or character values) to control output ports on the module without using the default web browser interface. The user notes a lack of sample implementations or official documentation to support this use case, highlighting difficulty in finding resources and guidance for this scenario.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for clear, beginner-focused documentation or sample code demonstrating how to easily send commands from a PC to a [product_name] module over Ethernet for controlling ports, especially solutions that do not require the web browser interface.
